exposure: spinal anesthesia supplemented with intrathecal morphine hydrochloride (ITM)
combined spinal-epidural anesthesia followed by opioid-free epidural analgesia (CSEA-EDA)
outcome: Time to first analgesic rescue after CD
cohort: Patients who underwent Cesarean delivery (CD) at Nagaoka Chuo General Hospital between February 2012 and January 2013.
finding: The study found that ITM was better than CSEA-EDA for anesthesia following CD with regard to pain control, and may be advantageous for early ambulation due to lower incidence of numbness and motor weakness in lower extremities.
